PATTERNS.repeats_claim: When someone interrupts you, you repeat the same point instead of finding a new angle.
PATTERNS.develops_argument: When someone interrupts you, you add a new argument instead of repeating.
PATTERNS.claims_without_evidence: You make strong claims without an example or a number.
PATTERNS.backs_claims_with_evidence: You back up your claims with a concrete example.
PATTERNS.agrees_too_quickly: You give in or agree too quickly when pushed.
PATTERNS.holds_position: You hold your position, or cleverly redirect it, under pressure.
PATTERNS.imprecise_vocabulary: You reach for general words where a precise one would carry the idea better.
PATTERNS.uses_precise_vocabulary: You choose precise words that fit the idea.
PATTERNS.states_position_clearly: You state your position clearly and directly.
PATTERNS.adapts_argument: You change the angle or tone of your argument to fit the other person.
PATTERNS.has_professional_context: You keep referring to a clear professional context.
PATTERNS.states_goals: You openly say what you want to get better at.
PATTERNS.avoids_topic: You step away from or redirect a topic you clearly don't want to discuss.

explainer.NAME: THE EXPLAINER
explainer.BRIEF: You rarely leave an idea unexplained.

reframer.NAME: THE REFRAMER
reframer.BRIEF: When challenged, you change the angle rather than abandon the position.

pushback_response.NAME: PUSHBACK RESPONSE
pushback_response.BRIEF: When someone disagrees, you explain before changing strategy.

closer.NAME: THE CLOSER
closer.BRIEF: Once you know where you are going, you know how to finish the point.

precision_under_pressure.NAME: PRECISION UNDER PRESSURE
precision_under_pressure.BRIEF: You become more precise when the stakes rise.

retreats_from_frames.NAME: LOSES THE FRAME
retreats_from_frames.BRIEF: You lose momentum when the other person refuses your initial frame.

evidence_first.NAME: EVIDENCE FIRST
evidence_first.BRIEF: You reach for a concrete fact before arguing.

story_driven.NAME: STORY-DRIVEN
story_driven.BRIEF: You move the argument forward through examples and stories.

hedges_too_early.NAME: HEDGES TOO EARLY
hedges_too_early.BRIEF: You soften the claim before giving it a chance to land.

controls_direction.NAME: CONTROLS DIRECTION
controls_direction.BRIEF: You steer the conversation toward the point you want to make.

premise_flip.NAME: Premise Flip
premise_flip.DESC: You don't argue the claim — you question what it rests on.
premise_flip.EXAMPLE: "Why does it have to work that way at all?"

clarifying_question.NAME: Clarifying Question
clarifying_question.DESC: A precise question that stops vague statements dead.
clarifying_question.EXAMPLE: "What exactly do you mean by efficient?"

emotional_anchor.NAME: Emotional Anchor
emotional_anchor.DESC: You stay calm and name the emotion instead of getting swept up in it.
emotional_anchor.EXAMPLE: "I get why that's frustrating. Here are the facts."

fact_check.NAME: Fact Check
fact_check.DESC: You don't take a claim at face value — you check it out loud.
fact_check.EXAMPLE: "Where does that number come from? Do you have a source?"

counterexample.NAME: Counterexample
counterexample.DESC: One sharp example that breaks their generalization.
counterexample.EXAMPLE: "And what about the time it went the other way?"

steelman.NAME: Steelman
steelman.DESC: You state your opponent's position better than they did — then counter exactly that.
steelman.EXAMPLE: "If I understand you right, you're saying… And still…"

short_thesis.NAME: Short Thesis
short_thesis.DESC: One short, decisive line instead of a three-minute explanation.

reframe.NAME: Reframe
reframe.DESC: You change the criteria the debate is being judged by.
reframe.EXAMPLE: "It's not about who's right. It's about what actually works."

POLICY.INTRO:
Before we start — a short note on what ARENA stores about you.

• Your messages in Temple, Battle and Free Talk.
• Voice messages — converted to text via OpenAI Whisper and NOT kept as audio.
• Profile: language, level, interests, speech patterns, debriefs.
• All of this is used only inside ARENA — to make the next conversation sharper.

You can clear your data at any time with /reset.

By continuing, you agree to this processing.
